_meta.description_pt: Banco de itens de nivelamento calibrado por nível CEFR. Campo 'b' = dificuldade em logits (modelo de Rasch/TRI). Pontos gramaticais/lexicais reais de cada nível.
_meta.description_en: Placement item bank calibrated by CEFR level. Field 'b' = difficulty in logits (Rasch/IRT model). Real grammar/lexis targets per level.

items.question: My name ___ Ana.
items.explanation_pt: 3ª pessoa do singular do verbo 'to be' é 'is'.
items.explanation_en: Third person singular of 'to be' is 'is'.

items.question: She is ___ engineer.
items.explanation_pt: Antes de som de vogal usa-se 'an' (an engineer).
items.explanation_en: Use 'an' before a vowel sound (an engineer).

items.question: They ___ in London.
items.explanation_pt: Com 'they' o present simple não leva -s.
items.explanation_en: With 'they' the present simple has no -s.

items.question: The day after Monday is ___.
items.explanation_pt: Depois de segunda (Monday) vem terça (Tuesday).
items.explanation_en: After Monday comes Tuesday.

items.question: I have two ___.
items.explanation_pt: Plural irregular: child → children.
items.explanation_en: Irregular plural: child → children.

items.question: This is ___ book. (belongs to me)
items.explanation_pt: Adjetivo possessivo antes do substantivo: 'my book'.
items.explanation_en: Possessive adjective before the noun: 'my book'.

items.question: Every morning I ___ coffee.
items.explanation_pt: Café a gente bebe (drink).
items.explanation_en: You drink coffee.

items.question: ___ a cat under the table.
items.explanation_pt: Singular (a cat) → 'There is'.
items.explanation_en: Singular (a cat) → 'There is'.

items.question: Yesterday we ___ to the beach.
items.explanation_pt: Passado simples de 'go' é 'went'.
items.explanation_en: Past simple of 'go' is 'went'.

items.question: This car is ___ than mine.
items.explanation_pt: Adjetivo curto: comparativo com -er (faster).
items.explanation_en: Short adjective: comparative with -er (faster).

items.question: Look at those clouds! It ___ rain.
items.explanation_pt: Previsão com evidência: 'be going to'.
items.explanation_en: Prediction from evidence: 'be going to'.

items.question: There isn't ___ milk in the fridge.
items.explanation_pt: Em frases negativas usa-se 'any'.
items.explanation_en: In negatives we use 'any'.

items.question: I need to ___ a decision.
items.explanation_pt: Colocação fixa: 'make a decision'.
items.explanation_en: Fixed collocation: 'make a decision'.

items.question: She ___ late for work.
items.explanation_pt: Advérbio de frequência vem depois do verbo 'to be': 'is never'.
items.explanation_en: Frequency adverb goes after 'to be': 'is never'.

items.question: How ___ money do you have?
items.explanation_pt: Money é incontável → 'much'.
items.explanation_en: Money is uncountable → 'much'.

items.question: "The shop is open from 9 to 6, closed on Sundays." When can you NOT go?
items.explanation_pt: Fecha aos domingos (closed on Sundays).
items.explanation_en: It's closed on Sundays.

items.question: I ___ never ___ sushi before.
items.explanation_pt: Experiência de vida: present perfect 'have + particípio (eaten)'.
items.explanation_en: Life experience: present perfect 'have + past participle (eaten)'.

items.question: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.
items.explanation_pt: Primeira condicional: if + presente, will + verbo.
items.explanation_en: First conditional: if + present, will + verb.

items.question: That's the woman ___ car was stolen.
items.explanation_pt: Posse em oração relativa: 'whose'.
items.explanation_en: Possession in a relative clause: 'whose'.

items.question: I ___ smoke, but I quit years ago.
items.explanation_pt: Hábito passado que não ocorre mais: 'used to'.
items.explanation_en: Past habit no longer true: 'used to'.

items.question: The meeting was ___ because of the storm.
items.explanation_pt: 'Call off' = cancelar.
items.explanation_en: 'Call off' = cancel.

items.question: I enjoy ___ to music.
items.explanation_pt: Após 'enjoy' usa-se gerúndio (-ing).
items.explanation_en: After 'enjoy' we use the gerund (-ing).

items.question: This exam was ___ more difficult than the last one.
items.explanation_pt: Intensificar comparativo: 'much more difficult'.
items.explanation_en: To intensify a comparative: 'much more difficult'.

items.question: "Despite the rain, they finished the hike." This means they ___.
items.explanation_pt: 'Despite' = apesar de; concluíram mesmo com chuva.
items.explanation_en: 'Despite' = in spite of; they finished it regardless.

items.question: If I ___ earlier, I wouldn't have missed the train.
items.explanation_pt: Terceira condicional: if + past perfect (had left).
items.explanation_en: Third conditional: if + past perfect (had left).

items.question: The bridge ___ in 1932.
items.explanation_pt: Voz passiva no passado: 'was built'.
items.explanation_en: Past passive voice: 'was built'.

items.question: She said she ___ the report the next day.
items.explanation_pt: Discurso indireto: 'will' vira 'would'.
items.explanation_en: Reported speech: 'will' becomes 'would'.

items.question: The new policy will have a huge ___ on small businesses.
items.explanation_pt: 'Have an impact on' é a colocação natural aqui.
items.explanation_en: 'Have an impact on' is the natural collocation here.

items.question: My eyes hurt because I ___ at the screen all day.
items.explanation_pt: Ação contínua com resultado presente: present perfect continuous.
items.explanation_en: Ongoing action with a present result: present perfect continuous.

items.question: I wish I ___ taller.
items.explanation_pt: 'Wish' + situação presente irreal usa 'were' (subjuntivo).
items.explanation_en: 'Wish' + unreal present uses 'were' (subjunctive).

items.question: Let's not jump to ___ before we have the facts.
items.explanation_pt: Idiom: 'jump to conclusions' (tirar conclusões precipitadas).
items.explanation_en: Idiom: 'jump to conclusions'.

items.question: "The proposal is ambitious, if somewhat unrealistic." The writer is ___.
items.explanation_pt: 'if somewhat unrealistic' sinaliza crítica branda.
items.explanation_en: 'if somewhat unrealistic' signals mild criticism.

items.question: ___ had I sat down when the phone rang.
items.explanation_pt: 'No sooner ... than' com inversão: 'No sooner had I...'.
items.explanation_en: 'No sooner ... than' with inversion: 'No sooner had I...'.

items.question: ___ we need is more time, not more money.
items.explanation_pt: Oração clivada com 'What' para dar ênfase.
items.explanation_en: Cleft sentence with 'What' for emphasis.

items.question: The evidence lends ___ to his theory.
items.explanation_pt: Colocação: 'lend weight to' (dar respaldo a).
items.explanation_en: Collocation: 'lend weight to' (support).

items.question: If she had taken the job, she ___ in Paris now.
items.explanation_pt: Condicional mista: causa no passado, resultado no presente ('would live now').
items.explanation_en: Mixed conditional: past cause, present result ('would live now').

items.question: His remarks were rather ___; nobody could tell what he really meant.
items.explanation_pt: 'Ambiguous' = ambíguo, sentido incerto.
items.explanation_en: 'Ambiguous' = open to more than one meaning.

items.question: ___ the instructions, she assembled the shelf easily.
items.explanation_pt: Oração participial: 'Having read' (após ter lido).
items.explanation_en: Participle clause: 'Having read'.

items.question: "One might, generously, call his effort adequate." The tone is ___.
items.explanation_pt: 'generously' + 'adequate' = elogio irônico/reticente.
items.explanation_en: 'generously' + 'adequate' = ironic, faint praise.

items.question: The committee decided to ___ the new regulations.
items.explanation_pt: 'Do away with' = abolir/eliminar.
items.explanation_en: 'Do away with' = abolish/eliminate.

items.question: After the scandal, the minister's career was left ___.
items.explanation_pt: 'In tatters' = em frangalhos/arruinada.
items.explanation_en: 'In tatters' = ruined.

items.question: The board insists that every member ___ present at the vote.
items.explanation_pt: Subjuntivo formal após 'insist that': verbo na forma base ('be').
items.explanation_en: Formal subjunctive after 'insist that': base form ('be').

items.question: Her prose is admirably ___: not a word is wasted.
items.explanation_pt: 'Terse' = conciso, econômico nas palavras.
items.explanation_en: 'Terse' = concise, economical.

items.question: "That he succeeded at all is, frankly, a triumph of luck over judgement." The writer implies his success was ___.
items.explanation_pt: 'luck over judgement' = deveu-se mais à sorte que ao mérito.
items.explanation_en: 'luck over judgement' = owed more to luck than to skill.

items.question: Not only ___ the deadline, but he also exceeded every target.
items.explanation_pt: 'Not only' no início força inversão: 'did he meet'.
items.explanation_en: 'Not only' fronted forces inversion: 'did he meet'.

items.question: The negotiations reached an ___ that neither side could break.
items.explanation_pt: 'Impasse' = beco sem saída nas negociações.
items.explanation_en: 'Impasse' = deadlock.

items.question: ___ his considerable talent, he never quite fulfilled his promise.
items.explanation_pt: 'For all' = apesar de todo (concessivo).
items.explanation_en: 'For all' = despite (concessive).

items.question: Don't let his charm ___; he's a ruthless negotiator.
items.explanation_pt: 'Take somebody in' = enganar/iludir.
items.explanation_en: 'Take somebody in' = deceive.

items.question: Yo ___ estudiante de español.
items.explanation_pt: O verbo 'ser' na 1ª pessoa do singular é 'soy'.
items.explanation_en: The verb 'ser' in the first person singular is 'soy'.

items.question: Me ___ María.
items.explanation_pt: 'Me llamo' é a forma padrão de apresentar o nome em espanhol.
items.explanation_en: 'Me llamo' is the standard way to introduce yourself in Spanish.

items.question: Ella ___ español todos los días.
items.explanation_pt: Na 3ª pessoa do singular do verbo '-ar', a terminação é '-a' (habla).
items.explanation_en: In the third person singular of '-ar' verbs, the ending is '-a' (habla).

items.question: ___ perro es grande.
items.explanation_pt: 'Perro' é masculino singular, então o artigo definido correto é 'El'.
items.explanation_en: 'Perro' is masculine singular, so the correct definite article is 'El'.

items.question: Tengo dos ___.
items.explanation_pt: Plural regular: 'libro' → 'libros' (adicionar -s).
items.explanation_en: Regular plural: 'libro' → 'libros' (add -s).

items.question: Nosotros ___ en la oficina.
items.explanation_pt: 'Estar' na 1ª pessoa do plural é 'estamos'. Usamos 'estar' para localização.
items.explanation_en: 'Estar' in the first person plural is 'estamos'. We use 'estar' for location.

items.question: Quiero ___ vasos de agua, por favor.
items.explanation_pt: 'Tres' é o número 3 em espanhol.
items.explanation_en: 'Tres' is the number 3 in Spanish.

items.question: ___ una farmacia cerca de aquí.
items.explanation_pt: 'Hay' é usado para expressar existência (corresponde a 'there is/are').
items.explanation_en: 'Hay' is used to express existence (equivalent to 'there is/are').

items.question: Ayer nosotros ___ al cine.
items.explanation_pt: Pretérito indefinido de 'ir' na 1ª pessoa do plural é 'fuimos'.
items.explanation_en: Past simple of 'ir' in the first person plural is 'fuimos'.

items.question: Mañana ___ a la playa.
items.explanation_pt: Futuro perifrástico: 'ir a' + infinitivo. A conjugação correta é 'voy a ir'.
items.explanation_en: Periphrastic future: 'ir a' + infinitive. The correct conjugation is 'voy a ir'.

items.question: Madrid es ___ grande que Barcelona.
items.explanation_pt: Comparativo de superioridade: 'más' + adjetivo + 'que'.
items.explanation_en: Comparative of superiority: 'más' + adjective + 'que'.

items.question: Ahora mismo ___ la cena.
items.explanation_pt: Ação em progresso: 'estar' + gerúndio (-ando/-iendo).
items.explanation_en: Progressive action: 'estar' + gerund (-ando/-iendo).

items.question: Necesito ___ una decisión importante.
items.explanation_pt: Colocação fixa: 'tomar una decisión' (tomar uma decisão).
items.explanation_en: Fixed collocation: 'tomar una decisión' (make a decision).

items.question: Hoy ___ tres cafés.
items.explanation_pt: Pretérito perfeito com 'hoy' (tempo recente): 'haber' + participio → 'he bebido'.
items.explanation_en: Present perfect with 'today' (recent time): 'haber' + past participle → 'he bebido'.

items.question: ___ la puerta, por favor.
items.explanation_pt: Imperativo afirmativo para 'tú': 'abre' (do verbo abrir).
items.explanation_en: Affirmative imperative for 'tú': 'abre' (from the verb abrir).

items.question: "La tienda abre de lunes a sábado, de 9 a 20 h." ¿Cuándo NO puedes ir?
items.explanation_pt: La tienda no abre los domingos.
items.explanation_en: The shop is not open on Sundays.

items.question: Ayer ___ una película, pero no me gustó mucho.
items.explanation_pt: Com 'ayer' e evento puntual no passado, usa-se o pretérito indefinido: 'vi'.
items.explanation_en: With 'yesterday' and a past specific event, we use the preterite: 'vi'.

items.question: Si llueve mañana, ___ en casa.
items.explanation_pt: Primeira condicional: se + presente do indicativo, verbo no condicional/futuro → 'quedaré'.
items.explanation_en: First conditional: if + present indicative, future/conditional tense → 'quedaré'.

items.question: Los alumnos ___ entregar el trabajo antes del viernes.
items.explanation_pt: 'Deber' + infinitivo expressa obrigação ou dever.
items.explanation_en: 'Deber' + infinitive expresses obligation or duty.

items.question: María dijo que ___ al día siguiente.
items.explanation_pt: No discurso indireto, o futuro do indicativo se transforma em condicional: 'vendría'.
items.explanation_en: In reported speech, the future indicative becomes conditional: 'vendría'.

items.question: Hoy ___ mucho frío.
items.explanation_pt: Em espanhol, 'frío' e 'calor' usam 'tener' (tenía frigo), não 'ser/estar'.
items.explanation_en: In Spanish, 'frío' and 'calor' use 'tener' (I'm cold), not 'ser/estar'.

items.question: Cuando llegué, ellos ___ de cenar.
items.explanation_pt: Pluscuamperfecto: 'haber' no pretérito imperfeito + participio → 'habían terminado'.
items.explanation_en: Pluperfect: 'haber' in imperfect + past participle → 'habían terminado'.

items.question: ___ estudiar mucho para el examen.
items.explanation_pt: 'Tener que' + infinitivo expressa necessidade pessoal.
items.explanation_en: 'Tener que' + infinitive expresses personal necessity.

items.question: "A pesar de la tormenta, terminaron la excursión." Esto significa que ___.
items.explanation_pt: 'A pesar de' = apesar de; eles concluíram a excursão mesmo com a tempestade.
items.explanation_en: 'A pesar de' = despite; they finished the excursion anyway.

items.question: Si hubiera estudiado, ___ el examen.
items.explanation_pt: Condicional compuesto: 'haber' no condicional + participio → 'habría aprobado'.
items.explanation_en: Conditional perfect: 'haber' in conditional + past participle → 'habría aprobado'.

items.question: La carta ___ ayer por la mañana.
items.explanation_pt: Voz passiva no pretérito: 'ser' no indefinido + participio → 'fue enviada'.
items.explanation_en: Past passive voice: 'ser' in preterite + past participle → 'fue enviada'.

items.question: Le pedí que ___ en silencio.
items.explanation_pt: Subjuntivo imperfeito após verbo de pedido/desejo: 'le pedí que hablara'.
items.explanation_en: Imperfect subjunctive after a verb of request/wish: 'le pedí que hablara'.

items.question: No lo hace bien; siempre busca ___.
items.explanation_pt: Modismo: 'buscar el rápido y fácil' = querer resultados sem esforço.
items.explanation_en: Idiom: 'buscar el rápido y fácil' = wanting easy results without effort.

items.question: Si hubiera aceptado el trabajo, ___ en Berlín ahora.
items.explanation_pt: Condicional mista: causa no passado (hubiera aceptado), resultado no presente (viviría).
items.explanation_en: Mixed conditional: past cause (hubiera aceptado), present result (viviría).

items.question: Esa es la profesora ___ hijos estudian conmigo.
items.explanation_pt: 'Cuyos' concorda em número e gênero com o substantivo que precede (hijos = masculino plural).
items.explanation_en: 'Cuyos' agrees in number and gender with the preceding noun (hijos = masculine plural).

items.question: ___ la lluvia, el evento se realizó con éxito.
items.explanation_pt: 'A pesar de' introduz uma oração concessiva (oposição/contraste).
items.explanation_en: 'A pesar de' introduces a concessive clause (opposition/contrast).

items.question: "La propuesta es ambiciosa, aunque algo poco realista." El autor está ___.
items.explanation_pt: 'Aunque algo poco realista' indica uma crítica moderada.
items.explanation_en: 'Aunque algo poco realista' indicates moderate criticism.

items.question: No había ___ terminado de comer cuando sonó el teléfono.
items.explanation_pt: 'Apenas' pode provocar inversão: 'No había apenas terminado...' (ou 'Apenas había terminado...').
items.explanation_en: 'Apenas' can trigger inversion: 'No había apenas terminado...' (or 'Apenas había terminado...').

items.question: Es increíble que ___ tan bien en el examen.
items.explanation_pt: Após adjetivos emocionais (increíble), usa-se o subjuntivo presente: 'haya sacado'.
items.explanation_en: After emotional adjectives (increíble), we use the present subjunctive: 'haya sacado'.

items.question: Los hallazgos ___. la hipótesis inicial del investigador.
items.explanation_pt: 'Corroborar' = confirmar, dar respaldo (registro formal/acadêmico).
items.explanation_en: 'Corroborar' = confirm, support (formal/academic register).

items.question: La ___ de las pruebas es esencial para el juicio.
items.explanation_pt: Nominalização: o substantivo abstrato 'presentación' (de 'presentar').
items.explanation_en: Nominalization: the abstract noun 'presentación' (from 'presentar').

items.question: Sus palabras fueron bastante ___; nadie entendió qué quería decir.
items.explanation_pt: 'Ambiguas' = com sentido incerto, múltiplas interpretações.
items.explanation_en: 'Ambiguas' = open to more than one meaning.

items.question: Estaría encantado, sin embargo ___ un poco más de tiempo para pensarlo.
items.explanation_pt: Na oração concessiva subordinada, o condicional suaviza o pedido: 'me gustaría tener'.
items.explanation_en: In a concessive subordinate clause, the conditional softens the request: 'me gustaría tener'.

items.question: "Uno podría, generosamente, llamar su esfuerzo aceptable." El tono es ___.
items.explanation_pt: 'Generosamente' + 'aceptable' = elogio irônico e reticente.
items.explanation_en: 'Generosamente' + 'aceptable' = ironic, faint praise.

items.question: El comité decidió ___ las nuevas regulaciones.
items.explanation_pt: 'Hacer cumplir' = implementar/impôr (registro formal).
items.explanation_en: 'Hacer cumplir' = enforce/impose (formal register).

items.question: Después del escándalo, la carrera del político quedó ___.
items.explanation_pt: 'Quedar en ruinas' = ficar arruinado/destruído (figurado).
items.explanation_en: 'Quedar en ruinas' = to be left in ruins (figurative).

items.question: Si yo ___ presidente, cambiaría la ley.
items.explanation_pt: Subjuntivo imperfeito com 'si' para situações irrealis: 'si yo fuera presidente'.
items.explanation_en: Imperfect subjunctive with 'si' for unreal situations: 'si yo fuera presidente'.

items.question: Su prosa es admirablemente ___: no sobra una palabra.
items.explanation_pt: 'Recortada' = concisa, econômica com as palavras (equivalente a 'terse' em inglês).
items.explanation_en: 'Recortada' = concise, economical with words (equivalent to 'terse' in English).

items.question: "Que haya tenido éxito es, francamente, un triunfo de la suerte sobre el criterio." El autor implica que su éxito fue ___.
items.explanation_pt: 'Suerte sobre criterio' = deveu-se mais à sorte do que ao mérito.
items.explanation_en: 'Suerte sobre criterio' = owed more to luck than to skill.

items.question: No obstante lo ___ por expertos, el proyecto fue rechazado.
items.explanation_pt: Participio passivo após verbo de agência ('lo recomendado por expertos') = valor adjetivo/concessivo.
items.explanation_en: Past participle after a verb of agency ('lo recomendado por expertos') = adjectival/concessive value.

items.question: Las negociaciones llegaron a un ___ que ninguna parte podía romper.
items.explanation_pt: 'Punto muerto' = impasse/estancamento nas negociações.
items.explanation_en: 'Punto muerto' = deadlock/impasse in negotiations.

items.question: ___ su considerable talento, nunca llegó a cumplir su promesa.
items.explanation_pt: 'A pesar de' = apesar de todo (concessão enfática em registro elevado).
items.explanation_en: 'A pesar de' = despite all (emphatic concession in formal register).

items.question: No te dejes engañar por su encanto; ___ es un negociador despiadado.
items.explanation_pt: 'Debajo del agua' = subterrâneo/oculto (alguém com segundas intenções por trás da aparência).
items.explanation_en: 'Debajo del agua' = underground/hidden (someone with hidden intentions behind appearance).

items.question: Je ___ étudiant.
items.explanation_pt: Conjugação do verbo 'être' no presente: je suis.
items.explanation_en: Present tense conjugation of 'être': je suis.

items.question: Comment ___-tu ?
items.explanation_pt: Interrogação com 'tu': t'appelles (pronome réfléchi 'te' elidido em 't').
items.explanation_en: Question with 'tu': t'appelles (reflexive pronoun 'te' elided to 't').

items.question: Nous ___ deux frères.
items.explanation_pt: Conjugação do verbo 'avoir' no presente: nous avons.
items.explanation_en: Present tense conjugation of 'avoir': nous avons.

items.question: ___ livre est sur la table.
items.explanation_pt: 'Livre' é masculino singular, então usa-se o artigo definido 'le'.
items.explanation_en: 'Livre' (book) is masculine singular, so use the definite article 'le'.

items.question: C'est ___ mère.
items.explanation_pt: O adjetivo possessivo concorda com o gênero do substantivo possuído: 'ma' para feminino (mère).
items.explanation_en: The possessive adjective agrees with the gender of the possessed noun: 'ma' for feminine (mère).

items.question: J'ai ___ chats à la maison.
items.explanation_pt: O número 'trois' (3) soletra-se t-r-o-i-s.
items.explanation_en: The number 'three' (3) is spelled t-r-o-i-s.

items.question: Tu ___ le pain au petit-déjeuner.
items.explanation_pt: Verbo regular -er com 'tu': o 'e' mudo do sujeito se funde com o '-e' do radical: tu manges → tu mange.
items.explanation_en: Regular -er verb with 'tu': the mute 'e' of the subject fuses with the '-e' of the stem: tu manges → tu mange.

items.question: ___-tu français ?
items.explanation_pt: Interrogação com 'tu' e verbe être: es-tu (2ª pessoa do singular).
items.explanation_en: Question with 'tu' and être: es-tu (2nd person singular).

items.question: J'___ mangé une pomme hier.
items.explanation_pt: Passé composé com avoir: j'ai mangé (participe passé invariável com avoir).
items.explanation_en: Passé composé with avoir: j'ai mangé (past participle invariable with avoir).

items.question: Marie ___ allée au marché.
items.explanation_pt: Verbos de movimento (aller, venir...) usam 'être' no passé composé. O participe concorda: allée (feminino).
items.explanation_en: Movement verbs (aller, venir...) use 'être' in passé composé. The participle agrees: allée (feminine).

items.question: Nous ___ partir demain matin.
items.explanation_pt: Futur proche: sujet + aller (conjugado) + infinitif. Nous allons partir.
items.explanation_en: Near future: subject + aller (conjugated) + infinitive. Nous allons partir.

items.question: Je ne mange ___ de viande.
items.explanation_pt: Negação com 'ne...jamais' = nunca. 'Ne...rien' = nada, 'ne...personne' = ninguém.
items.explanation_en: Negation with 'ne...jamais' = never. 'Ne...rien' = nothing, 'ne...personne' = nobody.

items.question: La robe est ___.
items.explanation_pt: O adjetivo 'rouge' já termina em -e, portanto é invariável em gênero e número.
items.explanation_en: The adjective 'rouge' already ends in -e, so it is invariable in gender and number.

items.question: Nous allons au cinéma ___ dimanche.
items.explanation_pt: Em francês, não se usa artigo antes dos dias da semana quando se refere a um dia específico.
items.explanation_en: In French, no article is used before days of the week when referring to a specific day.

items.question: Annonce : « Vente de livres d'occasion, 5 € la pièce. » Un livre coûte ___.
items.explanation_pt: O anúncio diz '5 € la pièce', ou seja, 5 euros por livro.
items.explanation_en: The ad says '5 € la pièce', meaning 5 euros per book.

items.question: Il ne ___ sort le soir.
items.explanation_pt: O advérbio de frequência 'jamais' vai entre 'ne' e o verbo principal: ne + jamais + verbe.
items.explanation_en: The frequency adverb 'jamais' goes between 'ne' and the main verb: ne + jamais + verbe.

items.question: Quand il ___, je lisais un livre.
items.explanation_pt: O imparfait descreve ações contínuas/habituals no passado que formam o cenário de outra ação.
items.explanation_en: The imparfait describes continuous/habitual past actions that set the scene for another action.

items.question: Si j'avais le temps, je ___ voyager.
items.explanation_pt: Conditionnel de primeira hipótese: si + imparfait + conditionnel présent (j'irais).
items.explanation_en: First conditional hypothesis: si + imparfait + conditionnel présent (I would go).

items.question: Il a dit qu'il ___ en retard.
items.explanation_pt: No discurso indireto, 'sera' (futur simple) torna-se 'serait' (conditionnel) após 'dire que'.
items.explanation_en: In reported speech, 'sera' (futur simple) becomes 'serait' (conditionnel) after 'dire que'.

items.question: Tu ___ finir ce rapport avant demain.
items.explanation_pt: 'Devoir' exprime obrigação: tu dois finir (obrigação). 'Pouvoir' seria possibilidade.
items.explanation_en: 'Devoir' expresses obligation: tu dois finir (obligation). 'Pouvoir' would be possibility.

items.question: C'est l'auteur ___ j'ai lu le dernier livre.
items.explanation_pt: 'Dont' substitui 'de + qui/quoi': j'ai lu le livre DE cet auteur → dont.
items.explanation_en: 'Dont' replaces 'de + qui/quoi': j'ai lu le livre DE cet auteur → dont.

items.question: J'ai entendu les enfants ___ dans le jardin.
items.explanation_pt: Após verbos de percepção (entendre, voir) e laisser, usa-se o infinitivo: entendre quelqu'un faire quelque chose.
items.explanation_en: After perception verbs (entendre, voir) and laisser, use the infinitive: entendre quelqu'un faire quelque chose.

items.question: Il pleut dehors, ___ nous sortons quand même.
items.explanation_pt: 'Cependant' introduz uma oposição entre duas ideias: chuva × sair apesar disso.
items.explanation_en: 'Cependant' introduces an opposition between two ideas: rain × going out despite it.

items.question: « Les négociations se sont terminées dans l'impasse. » Cela signifie que ___.
options: un accord partiel a été signé
items.explanation_pt: 'L'impasse' = beco sem saída. As negociações não chegaram a um acordo.
items.explanation_en: 'L'impasse' = deadlock. The negotiations did not reach an agreement.

items.question: Le pont ___ en 1932.
items.explanation_pt: Voz passiva no passé composé: a été construit (passé composé de être + participe passé).
items.explanation_en: Passive voice in passé composé: a été construit (passé composé of être + past participle).

items.question: Si j'avais étudié, j'___ l'examen.
items.explanation_pt: Condicional pasado (2ª forma): si + plus-que-parfait + aurais + participe passé.
items.explanation_en: Past conditional (2nd form): si + plus-que-parfait + aurais + past participle.

items.question: Le projet ___ je vous ai parlé est ambitieux.
items.explanation_pt: 'Dont' substitui 'de + lequel': je vous ai parlé DE ce projet → dont.
items.explanation_en: 'Dont' replaces 'de + lequel': je vous ai parlé DE ce projet → dont.

items.question: Il a fallu ___ de nouvelles mesures.
items.explanation_pt: 'Mettre en œuvre' = implementar/pôr em prática. Registo formal adequado a contexto institucional.
items.explanation_en: 'Mettre en œuvre' = to implement. Formal register appropriate for institutional context.

items.question: Il est possible qu'il ___ demain.
items.explanation_pt: 'Il est possible que' exige o subjonctivo: que + subjonctif (vienne).
items.explanation_en: 'Il est possible que' requires the subjunctive: que + subjonctif (vienne).

items.question: ___ les difficultés, ils ont réussi le projet.
items.explanation_pt: 'Malgré' + nom = apesar de (concessão). 'Grâce à' = graças a (causa positiva).
items.explanation_en: 'Malgré' + noun = despite (concession). 'Grâce à' = thanks to (positive cause).

items.question: « On ne peut que féliciter l'équipe pour son travail... même si le résultat reste modeste. » Le ton est ___.
items.explanation_pt: Elogio seguido de 'même si... modeste' revela um tom reticente, equilibrado entre elogio e restrição.
items.explanation_en: Praise followed by 'même si... modeste' reveals a restrained tone, balancing praise with qualification.

items.question: Ne ___ pas cette information pour argent comptant.
items.explanation_pt: 'Prendre pour argent comptant' = aceitar sem questionar (locução figurada).
items.explanation_en: 'Prendre pour argent comptant' = to take at face value (fixed expression).

items.question: ___ ne suis-je pas venu à la réunion.
items.explanation_pt: Com um advérbio négativo ou restrictivo em tête (rarement, à peine...), a inversão sujeito-verbo é obrigatória.
items.explanation_en: With a negative or restrictive adverb fronted (rarement, à peine...), subject-verb inversion is mandatory.

items.question: ___ l'argent ___ manque dans ce projet.
items.explanation_pt: Phrase clivée com 'c'est...qui' para dar ênfase ao sujeito: C'est l'argent qui manque.
items.explanation_en: Cleft sentence with 'c'est...qui' for emphasis on the subject: C'est l'argent qui manque.

items.question: L'entreprise a décidé de ___ le nouveau réglement.
items.explanation_pt: 'Apporter' = trazer/introduzir (no contexto de uma nova regra: apporter un changement).
items.explanation_en: 'Apporter' = to bring/introduce (in the context of a new rule: apporter un changement).

items.question: Si elle avait pris ce emploi, elle ___ à Paris en ce moment.
items.explanation_pt: Conditionnel misto: causa no passado (avait pris) + resultado no presente (vivrait).
items.explanation_en: Mixed conditional: past cause (avait pris) + present result (vivrait).

items.question: ___, la situation s'améliore lentement.
items.explanation_pt: 'Il semblerait que' exprime incerteza/utiliza o subjonctivo, atenuando a afirmação.
items.explanation_en: 'Il semblerait que' expresses uncertainty and uses the subjunctive, hedging the claim.

items.question: Bien qu'il ___ fatigué, il a continué à travailler.
items.explanation_pt: 'Bien que' (embora) é seguido obrigatoriamente do subjonctivo: bien qu'il soit fatigué.
items.explanation_en: 'Bien que' (although) is always followed by the subjunctive: bien qu'il soit fatigué.

items.question: « Ses discours sont, disons-le poliment, extrêmement originaux. » L'auteur est ___.
items.explanation_pt: 'Disons-le poliment' + 'extrêmement originaux' = eufemismo para esconder crítica. Tom irônico.
items.explanation_en: 'Disons-le poliment' + 'extrêmement originaux' = euphemism to mask criticism. Ironic tone.

items.question: Le projet a pour but ___ les inégalités.
items.explanation_pt: 'Avoir pour but de + infinitif' é a estrutura nominalizada correta: a pour but de réduire.
items.explanation_en: 'Avoir pour but de + infinitive' is the correct nominalized structure: a pour but de réduire.

items.question: Il est impératif que toutes les parties ___ un compromis.
items.explanation_pt: 'Il est impératif que' exige o subjonctivo: que + subjonctif (trouvent).
items.explanation_en: 'Il est impératif que' requires the subjunctive: que + subjonctif (trouvent).

items.question: Après le scandale, la carrière du ministre était en ___.
items.explanation_pt: 'En lambeaux' = em frangalhos/arruinado (expressão idiomática para destruição total).
items.explanation_en: 'En lambeaux' = in tatters/ruined (idiomatic expression for total destruction).

items.question: Son style est remarquablement ___ : pas un mot n'est superflu.
items.explanation_pt: 'Concis' = breve, econômico em palavras. 'Prolixe' = oposto, wordy.
items.explanation_en: 'Concis' = terse, economical in words. 'Prolixe' = verbose, the opposite.

items.question: « Que lui ait réussi du tout est, franchement, un triomphe de la chance sur le mérite. » L'auteur implique que son succès était ___.
items.explanation_pt: 'La chance sur le mérito' = o sucesso deveu-se mais à sorte do que ao talento/competência.
items.explanation_en: 'La chance sur le mérite' = success was owed more to luck than to skill.

items.question: Non seulement ___ le délai, mais il a aussi dépassé chaque objectif.
items.explanation_pt: 'Non seulement' en tête impose l'inversion: a-t-il respecté (inversion sujet-verbe).
items.explanation_en: 'Non seulement' fronted forces inversion: a-t-il respecté (subject-verb inversion).

items.question: Les négociations ont atteint une ___ que personne ne pouvait briser.
items.explanation_pt: 'Impasse' = ponto mort/sem saída nas negociações. Colocação fixa com 'atteindre une impasse'.
items.explanation_en: 'Impasse' = deadlock in negotiations. Fixed collocation with 'atteindre une impasse'.

items.question: ___ il fasse froid, il sort toujours sans manteau.
items.explanation_pt: 'Quand bien même' + subjonctivo = mesmo que/conquanto (concessão formal).
items.explanation_en: 'Quand bien même' + subjunctive = even if (formal concession).

items.question: « Il ferait preuve d'une certaine prudence quant aux résultats. » L'auteur est ___.
items.explanation_pt: 'Une certaine prudence quant aux résultats' = otimismo cauteloso, sem garantias.
items.explanation_en: 'Une certaine prudence quant aux résultats' = cautious optimism, without guarantees.
